metadata.description: Admin username for the Linux Virtual Machine.
SSH public key or secure password for the Linux Virtual Machine.
Authentication type for the Linux Virtual Machine: sshPublicKey or password.
Size of the Linux Virtual Machine (Standard_D2s_v5 has 2 vCPU and 8GB RAM, ideal for SFML + clangd).
Administrator login for Azure SQL Database.
Administrator password for Azure SQL Database.
Location for Azure SQL Server and Database (swedencentral has active SQL provisioning capacity).
SKU for Azure SQL Database (Basic is $5/month, 5 DTU, 2GB storage, ideal for 2-7 students).
Optional custom domain or DNS prefix for the Public IP.
Whether to create RBAC role assignments (requires Owner/User Access Administrator role). Set false for Contributor role.

osProfile.linuxConfiguration: [if(equals(parameters('vmAuthType'), 'sshPublicKey'), createObject('disablePasswordAuthentication', true(), 'ssh', createObject('publicKeys', createArray(createObject('path', format('/home/{0}/.ssh/authorized_keys', parameters('vmAdminUsername')), 'keyData', parameters('vmAdminPasswordOrKey'))))), null())]

connectionStringTemplate.value: [format('Server=tcp:{0},1433;Initial Catalog={1};Persist Security Info=False;User ID={2};Password=<PASSWORD>;MultipleActiveResultSets=False;Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=False;Connection Timeout=30;', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Sql/servers', variables('sqlServerName')), '2023-05-01-preview').fullyQualifiedDomainName, variables('sqlDatabaseName'), parameters('sqlAdminUsername'))]
